summary: The CriminalRecordsCheck file is part of the HSPnet user controls for managing enrollment processes. It involves various controls and functionalities focused on managing and updating student records related to criminal records checks.
purpose: To facilitate the management of student enrollment records, specifically handling the processes and validations involved in criminal records checks within the HSPnet system.
